chunks.heading: Cancelling a Flex membership
chunks.text: Flex has no minimum term. Cancel any time at reception or through the app with 14 days notice, and your last debit will be the one inside that notice period.

chunks.heading: Cancelling during a 12-month term
chunks.text: Standard and Premium are 12-month terms. To leave early there is a $150 early exit fee, plus 14 days notice. After the 12 months are up the membership rolls onto a no-term weekly plan at the same price and can be cancelled with 14 days notice and no fee.

chunks.heading: Moving away or medical reasons
chunks.text: If you move more than 30 km from any Tidewater club, or a doctor certifies you cannot exercise for the rest of your term, we waive the early exit fee. Bring proof of your new address or a medical certificate to reception.

chunks.heading: Freezing your membership
chunks.text: You can freeze a Standard or Premium membership for between 1 and 12 weeks per year. Freezes cost $3 a week, and your term end date moves back by the length of the freeze. Medical freezes with a doctor's note are free. Request a freeze at least 3 days before you want it to start.

chunks.heading: Transferring a membership
chunks.text: You can transfer the rest of your 12-month term to a friend or family member for a $30 admin fee. They need to come in with you to sign the transfer form and get their own access tag.

chunks.heading: Which classes are included
chunks.text: All group classes are included in Standard and Premium memberships. Flex members can book classes for $12 each. We run spin, HIIT, yoga, pilates, boxing fitness and strength classes, with around 45 classes a week.

chunks.heading: Booking a class
chunks.text: Book classes in the Tidewater app up to 7 days ahead. Bookings open at 6am each day. If a class is full you can join the waitlist and you will get a notification if a spot opens up.

chunks.heading: Late cancellations and no-shows
chunks.text: Please cancel at least 2 hours before the class starts. If you cancel late or do not show up three times in 30 days, you will not be able to book classes for 7 days.

chunks.heading: Beginners
chunks.text: Every class can be adjusted for beginners, so let the instructor know it is your first time. Yoga Foundations on Tuesday at 6pm and Strength Basics on Saturday at 9am are designed for people who are new to training.

chunks.heading: Guest passes
chunks.text: Premium members get two free guest passes each month. Anyone else can bring a guest for $15 a visit. Guests must be 16 or older, show photo ID and sign a waiver at reception, so guests can only visit during staffed hours.

chunks.heading: Casual visits
chunks.text: A casual day pass is $20 and can be bought at reception or in the app. A 10-visit concession card is $160 and lasts 6 months.

chunks.heading: Age limits
chunks.text: Members need to be 16 or older. Teenagers aged 14 and 15 can join with a parent or guardian's consent and must complete an induction, and they can only train during staffed hours.

chunks.heading: Creche
chunks.text: We have a creche for children from 6 months to 6 years, open Monday to Friday 8:30am to 12pm. It costs $5 per child per session, up to 90 minutes, and must be booked in the app.

chunks.heading: Staffed hours
chunks.text: Reception is staffed Monday to Friday 6am to 8pm, Saturday 7am to 4pm and Sunday 8am to 2pm. Public holiday hours are posted in the app a week ahead.

chunks.heading: 24/7 access
chunks.text: Standard and Premium members can use the gym 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with their access tag. Outside staffed hours, entry is through the side door on Harbour Lane, and the gym is monitored by CCTV with duress alarms in the changing rooms and on the gym floor.

chunks.heading: Lost access tags
chunks.text: A replacement access tag costs $15. Report a lost tag in the app straight away so we can deactivate it.

chunks.heading: Parking
chunks.text: There are 40 free car parks behind the building, limited to 2 hours between 6am and 6pm on weekdays. Bike racks are next to the main entrance. Please do not park in the spaces marked for the café next door.

chunks.heading: Lockers
chunks.text: Day lockers in the changing rooms are free; bring your own padlock or use the keypad lockers. Lockers are cleared at 11pm every night, and anything left is kept at reception for 14 days. Permanent lockers can be rented for $8 a month.

chunks.heading: Membership options
chunks.text: Tidewater Fitness has three memberships. Flex is $18 a week with no minimum term and gives access to the gym floor from 6am to 9pm. Standard is $22 a week on a 12-month term and includes 24/7 access and all group classes. Premium is $29 a week on a 12-month term and adds two guest passes a month, a monthly body composition scan and 10% off personal training.

chunks.heading: Joining fee
chunks.text: There is a one-off $49 joining fee, which covers your access tag and an induction session with a trainer. The joining fee is waived for students with a valid student ID and during our January and July promotions.

chunks.heading: Student and senior discounts
chunks.text: Students and people aged 65 or over get 20% off Standard and Premium memberships. Bring proof of eligibility to reception when you sign up. The discount cannot be combined with corporate rates.

chunks.heading: Corporate memberships
chunks.text: Companies with five or more staff joining can get a corporate rate of $19 a week on Standard. Ask your HR team to email corporate@tidewaterfitness.example to set it up.

chunks.heading: Payment
chunks.text: Memberships are paid weekly by direct debit, every Monday. If a payment fails we try again on Thursday and add a $5 dishonour fee. After two failed payments your access tag is paused until the balance is cleared.

chunks.heading: Prices
chunks.text: A 30-minute personal training session costs $45 and a 60-minute session costs $75. A pack of 10 60-minute sessions costs $650. Premium members get 10% off all personal training.

chunks.heading: Free induction
chunks.text: Every new member gets a free 45-minute induction with a trainer, who will show you the equipment and write a starter programme. Book it in the app or at reception within your first 30 days.

chunks.heading: Choosing a trainer
chunks.text: Our trainers' profiles and specialities, such as strength, weight loss, injury rehab and pre and post-natal training, are in the app. You can book a free 15-minute chat with any trainer before committing.

chunks.heading: Cancelling a session
chunks.text: Personal training sessions must be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance, or the session is charged in full.

chunks.heading: Towels and hygiene
chunks.text: Bring a towel to every session and wipe down equipment after use. Spray bottles and paper towels are at every station. Towel hire is $2.

chunks.heading: Refunds
chunks.text: Joining fees and casual passes are non-refundable. If you are charged by mistake, contact us within 30 days and we will refund the amount to your account within 5 working days.

chunks.heading: Lost property
chunks.text: Lost property is kept at reception for 14 days. Valuables such as phones, wallets and keys are kept in the safe.

chunks.heading: Feedback and complaints
chunks.text: Talk to the duty manager, use the feedback form in the app, or email hello@tidewaterfitness.example. We reply to every complaint within 2 working days.

chunks.heading: Privacy
chunks.text: We use your details only to manage your membership. CCTV footage is kept for 30 days unless it is needed for an incident.
